title: Conflict 1s tiebreak window is strictly-less-than, excluding the exact 1000ms boundary
evidence: wombat-go/internal/protocol/conflict.go:Resolve uses `math.Abs(float64(diffMS)) < float64(ConflictWindow.Milliseconds())` (1000); a diff of exactly 1000ms falls through to the last-write-wins branch instead of the version tiebreak. REQUIREMENTS R4 says 'within 1000ms'.
suggestion: Use `<=` if the window is meant to be inclusive; the sync-exchanges fixture only exercises the same-instant case, so this edge is untested either way. Same edge observed in rep2.

title: Durable cache rewrites the whole JSON snapshot on every mutation
evidence: wombat-go/internal/store/store.go:saveLocked() marshals all entities+relationships and does WriteFile+Rename; PutEntity/PutRelationship each call saveLocked(), so every single-row change is O(n) I/O over the full graph.
suggestion: Acceptable at fixture scale and satisfies R6 ('embedded DB or equivalent'); a real embedded KV/SQLite store or batched persistence would scale better under sync load. No action needed for conformance.

title: Version counter is process-monotonic (mod 1e6), not the reference perf-counter

suggestion: None — format output matches fixtures/version-strings.json (TestFormatCanonical/TestNewIsCanonicalAndMonotonic pass); the deviation is internal and documented.

title: Exclusive-since semantics (R3) sent verbatim; strict-greater comparison is server-side
evidence: wombat-go/internal/sync/engine.go:BuildRequest sends the persisted resp.ServerTime verbatim as filters.since; the strictly-greater-than comparison is the server's responsibility (documented in the package header).
suggestion: Correct for a client port — the checkable part of R3 (watermark is the server_time, never the local clock) holds; verified by TestExclusiveSinceWatermark.
